name: Software Engineering Defense Evaluation Rubric
description: 4-level quality criteria for SE final defense

criteria.name: Architecture & System Design
criteria.description: Quality and modularity of the system architecture
criteria.learningOutcome: PLO-1: Ability to architect scalable and modular software solutions
criteria.evidenceGuidance: Inspect C4 diagrams, ADR records, and module boundaries in repo

levels.label: Poor
levels.descriptor: No clear architectural pattern or excessive coupling between components.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.descriptor: Basic layered architecture with documented components but minor boundary leaks.

levels.label: Good
levels.descriptor: Clean modular architecture with well-defined contracts and architectural decision records.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Exemplary Clean Architecture with comprehensive ADRs, automated boundary enforcement, and trade-off analysis.

criteria.name: Testing & Verification
criteria.description: Verification of core features through automated and acceptance tests
criteria.learningOutcome: PLO-2: Ability to apply testing techniques ensuring software reliability
criteria.evidenceGuidance: Inspect unit and integration test suites and CI pipeline execution logs

levels.label: Poor
levels.descriptor: Little to no automated testing; core workflows unverified.

levels.label: Satisfactory
levels.descriptor: Basic unit tests for critical paths; coverage below 60%.

levels.label: Good
levels.descriptor: Comprehensive unit and integration test suite covering standard and failure flows.

levels.label: Excellent
levels.descriptor: Full test pyramid with high coverage, property/boundary tests, and zero flaky tests in CI.
